name: Prep Supplies
description: Track your emergency supplies (food, water, medicine, first aid, batteries, fuel and more) with quantities and expiry dates, see how many days the water and food would last your household, and what a basic 72-hour kit still lacks. It does not check weather alerts (the weather package does that), does not order anything, and does not remind you on its own; you ask, or look at the page.
author: Cypher Sisters

tools.add_supply: Add an emergency supply (food, water, medicine, batteries, fuel, first aid and so on) with its quantity, unit and expiry date.
tools.update_supply: Change an emergency supply: its quantity, unit, expiry date, name, category or daily use.
tools.remove_supply: Take an emergency supply off the list.
tools.list_supplies: List the emergency supplies: all, one category, or only those expired or expiring in the next 30 days.
tools.days_remaining: How many days the stored water and food would last the household, with the assumptions used.
tools.checklist: What a basic 72-hour emergency kit still lacks, compared with the supplies stocked.

consent: Prep Supplies keeps your supplies list in its own data folder on this computer (prep.json). It does not use the internet and does not use the brain.
